next.headline: GOLD LOCUST: a threat actor tracked by Secureworks
next.in_short: Secureworks tracks GOLD LOCUST. The catalogue lists five other names for it and one tool, Carbanak. No public report in this library describes its operations.

sentences.t: Secureworks tracks this actor under the name GOLD LOCUST.
The catalogue lists its other names as Anunak, Carbanak, Carbon Spider, FIN7 and Silicon.
The one tool the catalogue links to the actor is Carbanak.
No public report in this library describes its operations.
